justification: White-label duplex checker: /embed/upzoning (iframe-embeddable, partner-branded) + /widget-demo/[slug] demo pages for the 20 builder outreach targets, driven by a partner registry with param sanitizers. Third surface over the existing upzoning engine; no planning logic added or changed.

pre_impl.existing_data: Reuses the /api/upzoning proxy, PropertySearch, and lib/upzoning verdict helpers exactly as app/duplex-check/page.tsx (merged same day, #789) does; follows the app/embed/<tool> pattern whose layout already handles domain logging and noindex. Partner sites/contact URLs were live-verified during outreach research on 2026-07-19 and mirror the HubSpot records created the same day.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Prior-art guard fired on the registry file and pointed at lib/sanitize.ts — inspected: it is DOMPurify HTML sanitisation for dangerouslySetInnerHTML and cannot validate URL protocols or whitelist a name pattern for query params, so the two purpose-built sanitizers were justified and the ack line records that reasoning.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New: presentation registry, compact widget component, embed route, demo shell, tests. Deliberately NOT new: eligibility logic (services/upzoning_check.py untouched), BuilderReferralCard (excluded by design — the white-label enquiry belongs to the partner, not our referral pool), no per-partner API keys yet (pilot phase counts usage via posthog partner property; keys come with billing).

functions.name: getWidgetPartner
functions.input: the ref query param or demo route slug, untrusted, typed string | string[] | undefined because Next.js delivers repeated params as arrays
functions.output: the matching WidgetPartner config object from the in-repo registry of 20 verified builders — the ONLY source of branding and CTA (free-form params removed after the PR #790 cross-review found a brand-spoof pairing)
functions.if_none: returns null on unknown slug, empty, undefined, or array input — the embed renders unbranded with no CTA button, and the demo page calls notFound() so an invalid outreach link 404s instead of showing a broken brand

values: N/A - no DB or API values are read by this change; the registry holds presentation values only (names, https URLs) and all planning data arrives from /api/upzoning at request time.
queries: N/A - no database access in this change.

break_it.scenario: A third party pairs a registered builder's NAME with an attacker CTA — either via ref+cta or via the free-form params (?partner=Buildana&cta=https://phishing.example).
break_it.what_happens: A real brand would launder a hostile enquiry link on an eligible verdict.
break_it.how: Free-form partner/cta params were REMOVED after the cross-review flagged the pairing (name-vs-registry checks cannot close typosquats). Branding + CTA resolve only from the in-repo registry by exact ref slug; array refs are rejected. Registry test asserts every ctaUrl stays on the partner's own registrable domain.
break_it.repro: Load /embed/upzoning?partner=Buildana&cta=https://evil.example — renders the unbranded checker, no CTA at all.

break_it.scenario: A visitor checks address A, quickly checks address B, and A's slower response arrives last — the widget silently shows A's verdict under B's search.
break_it.what_happens: A wrong verdict for the address on screen, worst on a negative verdict which does not repeat the address.
break_it.how: Monotonic request-id guard in handleAddressSelect: only the latest selection's response may write result/error/loading state; stale responses return without touching state.
break_it.repro: Throttle the network, run two rapid address selections — only the second's verdict renders.

break_it.scenario: The dual-occupancy form comes back unconfirmed (a required government map gave no clear answer) and the headline says a definitive 'Not this block'.
break_it.what_happens: Three-state semantics collapse to a false no — the exact silent-wrong-result class the QA framework exists for. app/duplex-check/page.tsx from #789 had the identical collapse.
break_it.how: Indeterminate branch added in BOTH surfaces (DuplexCheckWidget and the /duplex-check ads page): renders 'Not determinable from the government maps' with the plain reason; no partner CTA and no referral card on indeterminate (CTA spec: eligible results only — the eligible && guards already enforce this).
break_it.repro: Run an address whose dual-occ form returns unconfirmed=true on either surface — amber needs-a-closer-look card, not the grey no.

break_it.scenario: The computed verdict bends toward the partner — e.g. an ineligible block renders softer or the CTA appears on a non-eligible result to farm enquiries.
break_it.what_happens: The neutrality rule that protects the InfoTrack/licensing trust asset would be broken.
break_it.how: Verdict rendering is a pure function of the API result and identical with or without partner props; the CTA renders only under dualOccEligible(result) && ctaUrl. The component header documents the hard rule.
break_it.repro: Run a heritage-area address on any /widget-demo page: verdict is the same 'Not this block' as the public tool, no partner CTA shown.

break_it.scenario: javascript: or data: URL injected via the cta param executes in the visitor's browser from inside a builder's site.
break_it.what_happens: XSS on a partner's domain — reputationally fatal.
break_it.how: sanitizeCtaUrl parses with new URL() and only https: survives; jest covers javascript:, data:, http:, garbage, and undefined.

break_it.scenario: Inside the iframe, posthog events are blocked by tracking prevention, so pilot usage reports undercount and the weekly per-builder report claims fewer checks than happened.
break_it.what_happens: Under-reporting our own product's performance to the exact audience we are trying to convert.
break_it.how: Known limitation: client events may be dropped by ITP/adblock. The embed layout already logs an embed_request server-side per load (domain + tool), which gives a load-count floor. Per-partner server-side check counting lands with the API-key work; until then pilot reports must state counts are a floor, not an exact figure.
break_it.repro: Load the embed with an adblocker: embed_request still logs server-side; tool_run may not.

post_merge.db_reset: Not required - no database or schema changes.
post_merge.other_repo: None. The outreach emails doc (~/.claude/plans/ce-builder-widget-outreach-emails-2026-07.md) carries the demo URLs — its send-gate flips once this deploys and links are click-tested.
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - on the Vercel preview: (1) /widget-demo/buildana renders the mock-browser demo with Buildana's name and the CTA pointing at buildana.com.au/contact; (2) /widget-demo/unknown-slug 404s; (3) /embed/upzoning?ref=clover-homes runs a check end-to-end and the enquiry button opens the partner contact page in a new tab; (4) an ineligible address shows the same verdict as /duplex-check with no CTA.
